about.title: About Me
about.content: AI Engineer with experience in developing intelligent systems and advanced audiovisual applications. Skilled in designing intelligent systems that combine computer vision, deep learning, and interactive technologies. Experienced with C++, Python, and modern AI frameworks. Passionate about leveraging technical expertise to solve complex problems, deliver practical AI solutions, and continuously learn emerging technologies.

items.name: Oasi
items.subtitle: AI‑powered productivity suite (notes, chat, jobs, calendar, tasks)
highlights: Smart note‑taking with EditorJS and AI inline toolbar (RAG).
AI chat with local/cloud model selection and document integration.
Job management: scraping, dashboard, tracking, and smart filtering.
Calendar/scheduling and task management modules with tags & folders.
Roadmap-driven architecture; MIT licensed.
items.summary: Unified workspace that brings together AI notes, chat, job tracking, scheduling and tasks.

items.name: Advanced Image Editor
items.subtitle: Desktop image editor with AI (SAM segmentation + SD inpainting)
highlights: Core tools: exposure, color grading, curves, histogram; transform (crop/rotate/flip).
AI features: auto‑segmentation (SAM), mask generation, generative inpainting.
Masking system with multiple masks and selective region editing.
GPU acceleration with CPU fallback; modular, service‑layer architecture.
Export to PNG/JPG/TIFF/BMP; MIT licensed.
items.summary: Combines classic photo tools with modern AI for segmentation and content replacement.

items.name: Isolated Sign Language Recognition
items.subtitle: Pose‑landmark pipeline + Transformer classifier (100 classes)
highlights: Extracts pose/hand/face landmarks; handles gaps via cubic interpolation & confidence filters.
Augmentation (rotation, zoom, shift, re‑anchoring wrists) and normalization to body frame.
Transformer model with positional encoding, multi‑head attention, LayerNorm & dropout.
Evaluation scripts (precision/recall/F1, confusion matrix) and webcam real‑time demo.
Utilities for landmark comparison videos and early stopping callbacks.
items.summary: End‑to‑end pipeline for isolated sign recognition using landmarks and Transformers.

items.name: Intel RealSense SR300 / DepthSense Utilities
items.subtitle: Legacy depth camera toolkit for SR300/Senz3D: capture, view, calibrate, and export
highlights: Device support for Intel RealSense SR300 and Creative BlasterX Senz3D (DepthSense).
Depth/IR/RGB streaming with synchronized capture; basic point-cloud preview.
Intrinsic/extrinsic calibration helpers and frame alignment (depth-to-RGB).
Recording to lossless image stacks / simple NPZ sequences for ML pipelines.
Dockerized environment for deprecated SDKs on modern Linux distros.
items.summary: Tools to keep older RealSense/DepthSense depth cameras usable on modern systems.
